title: WHIL’s Picture of the Week
content:
11th February 2015

It’s not very often I manage to get out of the studio and shoot some landscapes – although I do enjoy it.

This shot of Glastonbury Tor was taken late in the afternoon last weekend as the sun was beginning to set and the temperature was dropping at the top of Ebbor Gorge (near Wookey Hole).

This was my first visit to Ebbor Gorge and I wasn’t let down by the amazing views from the top, next time I’ll wear some appropriate footwear and take my tripod.
 
The sun looked incredible across all the surrounding fields and the mist rolling around behind The Tor would have made for a great time lapse.
 

As always, we’re interested in getting our reader photos as Photo of the Week. If you have any images you’d like to share with the world (well, mainly Bristol) please send them to contact@thefixmagazine.com with the subject ‘Photo of the week’.

Will Fahy
